Most (including s000014 and s000041) end with Jun retrieving the book while Mina draws the moon from her atlas. A small branch (s000021, s000034, s000035, s000038, s000007) has Mina return the atlas and draw a whale instead. Differences in phrasing, such as “spotted” versus “saw,” do not create distinct plots. This sample alone does not establish the generator's overall diversity.

plot_groups.summary: Mina wants to draw the moon while helping Jun locate his missing whale book; an adult retrieves it from a high shelf, and Mina draws from her reserved moon atlas.
Mina chooses to set aside her moon atlas and help Jun; after the whale book is retrieved, she uses it to draw a whale.
